page.layout: One printed page, a calendar table in four columns of day, dominical letter and annual number (Dies, Septemb., October, Novemb., Decemb.), with a right-hand margin of small notes and a footnote line below the table; running head at top; signature and catchword at foot.

main_text.l: Dies | Septemb. di. 30. | October di. 31. | Novemb. di. 30. | Decemb. di. 31.

page.notes: The faint text in the upper right (the Calendarium heading and a column of Latin lines about Anno Christi and cycle) is show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The footer "CALEN" at lower left is show-through. The table's right margin note "Annus bissextilis dies continet 366." is treated as a side note in the page footer area.
